metadata.title: The selloff in tech stocks is shifting into overdrive - MarketWatch

content.text:
Market Extra
The selloff in tech stocks is shifting into overdrive
The Nasdaq Composite just logged its worst day since June, and its worst month in a year and a half
Technology stocks had been priced for perfection.
Yet a series of less-than-stellar earnings results from some of the world’s most important tech companies is causing fears to intensify around a possible slowdown in the aggressive pace of the artificial-intelligence build-out. That, in turn, threatens a key pillar of the market’s success over the past four years.
